examples.name: platformer
examples.source: A platform game: jump between three platforms to a blue exit. Falling restarts the attempt.
examples.first_playable: One room, three platforms, one reachable blue exit.
examples.deferred_scope: Additional levels, enemies and online leaderboards are later milestones.

examples.name: top_down_collector
examples.source: A top-down garden: collect three seeds and reach the gate, with readable movement and a visible counter.
examples.first_playable: One garden room, three seeds, one gate and a repeatable reset.
examples.deferred_scope: Larger gardens, upgrades and extra characters are later milestones.

examples.name: puzzle
examples.source: A tile puzzle: use legal clicks to match one displayed target, with a clear solved state.
examples.first_playable: One small board and one target; invalid moves do not change the board.
examples.deferred_scope: Puzzle generation, level packs and social sharing are later milestones.

examples.name: oversized_multiplayer
examples.source: My ambition is a persistent multiplayer archipelago with thousands of players, trade, flying, procedural islands, chat and cross-platform accounts. Keep this whole ambition visible.
examples.first_playable: Proposed first milestone: one local player collects three tokens on one island and reaches an exit.
examples.deferred_scope: Persistent multiplayer, trading, procedural worlds, chat and accounts remain part of the original ambition, deferred for separate review.
examples.review_note: The single-player slice is an editable human proposal, not an inferred or accepted AI decision.
